notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Nephalia Smuggler.
Nephalia Smuggler does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Nephalia Smuggler.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.
